MAKE YOUR OWN MOODBOARD

Find your feeling.
Follow the little details.

01

Notice the palette

Look for the colours you return to. Soft neutrals, joyful colour or a dramatic evening mood can become a starting point.

02

Look at the setting

Think about your venue, the time of day and the spaces you want to decorate. Scale changes the way a concept feels.

03

Make it personal

Share your favourite image title along with your own ideas. We’ll discuss what may work for your occasion.
